prompts.circle: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: reusable transparent collage decoration for a Japanese friendly glossy app. Generate a perfectly circular, front-facing, shallow domed disc, chartreuse lime yellow-green (#c9ec19). The disc occupies 86% of a square image. The body is perfectly round, not a sphere and not an ellipse. Material: exceptionally polished high-quality soft glossy resin matching friendly glossy 3D app icons, smooth top-to-bottom same-hue shading, luminous upper face, slightly deeper lower face and subtly darker rounded perimeter. One short milky-white capsule-shaped horizontal reflection with rounded ends at the UPPER LEFT of the object, gracefully integrated into its curvature. Soft tiny contact shadow only beneath the object, also on transparent alpha. Straight-on orthographic view, symmetrical geometry, no perspective tilt. No symbols, lettering, faces, texture, sparkles, metallic chrome, glass transparency or extra objects. Transparent background with real alpha; no checkerboard baked into pixels. This is the actual polished artwork, not a flat vector shape.
